a) Card: political service, main source of the electoral authority (communicato), then analysts, the spokesman

of the Alliance, authority; context: four-month government crisis last year, dissolution of parliament, early elections. Table: National Renaissance 87 seats (in the lead, without an absolute majority) · Democratic Alliance 68 (−10) · Youth Movement 31 (new) · Green Front 0 (under the threshold, outside the parliament). The Democratic Alliance has filed appeals in five colleges, speaking of irregularity during the investigation; the authority states that the vote took place in a climate of transparency and that observers did not report any infringements likely to affect the results. The president will appoint the leader of the first party within two weeks of the final results; The scenario Rebirth is given as probable ( ⁧من المرجح⁩ ), while the Alliance excluded to participate. Attribution verbs: ⁧أفادت⁩ · ⁧أكدت⁩ · ⁧قال⁩ · ⁧استبعد⁩ . Frames: ⁧وفق ما أفادت⁩
b) Article of opinion signed. Thesis: Young people are not indifferent to politics, but the parties do not speak their

language. It rejects the explanation of "indifference" (young people discuss much unemployment, school, home). Two causes: leadership of parties in the same generation, few young people at the top of the lists; programmes with generic promises that do not become concrete policies. He asked the parties to open up: give the young real places in the leadership and lists, talk with them and not about them. Markers: ⁧لكنني أرى⁩ · ⁧في تقديري⁩
